name: B10-0429/2025 (Renew) – 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It marks ten years since Swedish publisher Gui Minhai was taken in Thailand and held in China, and it condemns his arrest, secret trial and ten-year sentence. It asks China to release him, let him return to Sweden, and allow visits from Swedish officials and his family. It also urges the European Union's diplomatic service, the Commission and member states to keep raising his case with China.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament only states an opinion and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Gui Minhai, his family, Sweden, and European Union relations with China.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies and the Chinese government.
